description: The project evaluates waterflood performance in low-permeability sandstones using four multistage-fractured horizontal wells in Pembina Cardium Unit 9. Listed reports cover 2009–2011, 2012 and a 2013 final report, with appendices for the first period. These materials document a physical extraction-process trial. The metadata does not provide fracture geometry, flow rates, numerical recovery outcomes or an executable model. The original title uses multi-state; the description uses multi-stage, and the descriptive English title follows the stated engineering process. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue supplies the original Alberta identifiers and distribution descriptions. The licence and reuse terms are not stated. Costs and present file access remain unverified. This record covers inspected descriptive metadata; no dataset, document, archive or linked resource body was fetched. Specific simulation uses are unstated unless described above.
